verdict.rationale: Lago has a native revenue analytics page, so analytics come from the billing platform itself rather than a BI export. That page only says you can build per-customer dashboards, filter them and export to CSV. None of the specific metrics in the story are documented, and a community commenter could not find revenue reporting in the docs, though that is an open question rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: documented MRR metric, churn metric, cohort retention analysis, LTV calculation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the analytics.
